title: Beyond Visual Fidelity: Benchmarking Super-Resolution Models for Large-Scale Remote Sensing Imagery via Downstream Task Integration
abstract: arXiv:2605.00310v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Super-resolution (SR) techniques have made major advances in reconstructing high-resolution images from low-resolution inputs. The increased resolution provides visual enhancement and utility for monitoring tasks. In particular, SR has been increasingly developed for satellite-based Earth observation, with applications in urban planning, agriculture, ecology, and disaster response. However, existing SR studies and benchmarks typically use fidelity metrics such as PSNR or SSIM, whereas the true utility of super-resolved images lies in supporting downstream tasks such as land cover classification, biomass estimation, and change detection. To bridge this gap, we introduce GeoSR-Bench, a downstream task-integrated SR benchmark dataset to evaluate SR models beyond fidelity metrics. GeoSR-Bench comprises spatially co-located, temporally aligned, and quality-controlled image pairs from about 36,000 locations across diverse land covers

translated_title: 超越视觉保真度：通过下游任务集成对大规模遥感影像超分辨率模型进行基准评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.00310v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：超分辨率（SR）技术在从低分辨率输入重建高分辨率图像方面已取得重大进展。提升的分辨率不仅带来视觉上的增强，也对监测任务具有实用价值。尤其是，超分辨率技术正越来越多地被开发用于基于卫星的对地观测，其应用涵盖城市规划、农业、生态学和灾害响应等领域。然而，现有的超分辨率研究和基准测试通常采用PSNR或SSIM等保真度指标，而超分辨率图像的真正价值在于支持诸如土地覆盖分类、生物量估计和变化检测等下游任务。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了GeoSR-Bench，这是一个下游任务集成的超分辨率基准数据集，用于在保真度指标之外评估超分辨率模型。GeoSR-Bench包含来自约36,000个位置、覆盖多样土地覆盖类型的空间位置对应、时间对齐且经过质量控制的图像对。
tldr: 该论文提出了GeoSR-Bench基准数据集，通过将土地覆盖分类、生物量估计、变化检测等下游任务集成到评估流程中，突破传统PSNR/SSIM保真度指标的局限，实现对遥感影像超分辨率模型实用价值的更全面评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GeoSR-Bench, a downstream-task-integrated benchmark dataset that evaluates super-resolution models for large-scale remote sensing imagery beyond traditional fidelity metrics such as PSNR and SSIM.
